mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during periods of accelerated GDPC1 growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market, which raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE < 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 (2007=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of INDPRO < 98.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.25% signals a tightening monetary stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS > 5.25% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below 0.3% quarter-over-quarter signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of GDPC1 < 0.3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE > 6.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% combined with a 3-month increase in the civilian labor force participation rate (not available in catalog) signals a tightening labor market, which raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE < 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
